weapons.name: CPX-3 polymer compact .380 ACP
weapons.source_note: SCCY Industries official product description, verbatim: "Chambered for 380ACP, it has a 2.96\" barrel with a 16:1\" right hand twist." SCCY writes the ratio as 16:1, meaning 1 turn in 16 inches, right hand = 406.4 mm per turn. The same SCCY description is repeated verbatim across many SCCY dealer listings, and SCCY's own catalogue and owner's manual do not state a twist.

weapons.name: MCX Rattler 5.5" SBR
weapons.source_note: SIG Sauer factory specification for the 5.5 in .300 BLK Rattler, verbatim: "Barrel Length: 5.5 in (140 mm) ... Twist Rate: 1:5". 1 turn in 5 inches = 127.0 mm per turn. Corroborated by SIG Sauer's own MCX-RATTLER LT product page, which lists the .300 BLK Rattler twist as 1:5 (archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20231116221830id_/https://www.sigsauer.com/mcx-rattler-lt.html).
